response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) as overall_avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(track_count) as overall_avg_track_count FROM (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS FLOAT) / CAST(Milliseconds AS FLOAT)) as avg_bytes_per_ms, COUNT(*) as track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) subquery

assumptions.assumption: The size cutoff is inclusive: Bytes >= 10,323,804 (not exclusive). This is standard for 'large file' thresholds, where files at or above the cutoff qualify.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is exclusive: Bytes > 10,323,804 rather than Bytes >= 10,323,804. This would exclude files exactly at the cutoff size.
